title: LUCAID: Agentic Multimodal AI for Lung Cancer Precision Pathology
abstract: arXiv:2608.23803v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lung cancer tissue diagnostics is complex, as therapy decisions in precision oncology rely on the integration of histomorphological, immunohistochemical, and molecular features. Yet pathological assessment remains largely visual and semi-quantitative and shows interobserver variability, while existing artificial intelligence (AI) tools cover only selected tasks, rarely reach generalizable expert-level performance, and lack prospective clinical validation. To address these challenges, we developed and clinically validated LUCAID, an agentic AI system for precision lung cancer pathology. An integrative agent couples diagnostic reasoning with nine modules that cover the full routine workflow, from quality control, tumor detection and segmentation, histological subtyping, tumor microenvironment profiling, tumor cellularity quantification, and predictive biomarker scoring (PD-L1, MET, TROP-2) to automated structured report generation. LUCAI

translated_title: LUCAID：面向肺癌精准病理学的智能体多模态人工智能系统
translated_abstract: 肺癌组织诊断十分复杂，因为精准肿瘤学中的治疗决策依赖于组织形态学、免疫组织化学和分子特征的整合。然而，病理评估在很大程度上仍依赖视觉和半定量方法，存在观察者间差异，而现有人工智能（AI）工具仅覆盖特定任务，很少能达到可推广的专家级性能，且缺乏前瞻性临床验证。为应对这些挑战，我们开发并临床验证了LUCAID，一个用于精准肺癌病理学的智能体AI系统。一个整合型智能体将诊断推理与九个模块相结合，覆盖完整常规工作流程，从质量控制、肿瘤检测与分割、组织学亚型分型、肿瘤微环境分析、肿瘤细胞占比量化、预测性生物标志物评分（PD-L1、MET、TROP-2）到自动化结构化报告生成。LUCAI
tldr: LUCAID是一个经临床验证的智能体多模态AI系统，通过整合九个模块覆盖肺癌病理全流程，实现了从质量控制到生物标志物评分及报告生成的自动化精准诊断。
en_tdlr: LUCAID is a clinically validated agentic multimodal AI system that integrates nine modules to cover the full lung cancer pathology workflow, enabling automated precision diagnosis from quality control to biomarker scoring and report generation.
